label: Job search
summary: Applications, letters, follow-ups and interviews, tracked until a contract is signed. The assistant prepares everything and sends nothing.

first_phase.title: Application kit: masters, tracking file, content rules

questions.ask: Which role are you applying for? One line, the title as employers write it.
Your current situation in one line: employed (role, contract type), between jobs, student, other.
Where and how: city or remote, full-time or part-time, the sectors you want, the ones you refuse.

phases.title: Application kit: masters, tracking file, content rules
First wave: one employer folder at a time, each sent by you before the next
Offer watch: boards and career pages filtered on the trade, folders prepared up to ready
Follow-ups at ten working days; one interview sheet per employer
Offer, negotiation, notice period; the cockpit closes on signature
